title: Windlas Biotech Ltd - 543329 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Windlas Biotech FY26 revenue rose 19% to INR904 crores, with Q4 revenue up 18% to INR238 crores and reported PAT of INR66 crores for the year.
summary.overview: FY26 revenue crossed INR900 crores for the first time, growing 19% YoY, and Q4 extended the company's run to 13 consecutive quarters of record revenue. CDMO drove growth (+20% YoY), while Trade Generics slowed in Q3 and Q4 due to the loss of a codeine cough syrup business. Exports grew 40% for the year and 67% in Q4, and management reported net operating cash flow of INR105 crores and net liquidity of INR251 crores. Plant 6 has reached mechanical completion and is on track for commercialisation by H1 FY27.

financial_highlights.metric: Trade Generics and Institutional revenue FY26

segments.name: CDMO (Generic Formulations)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR664 crores (+20% YoY), Q4 INR176 crores (+20% YoY); about 73% of revenue. Top customer 6.5% of revenue, top 10 about 32%, top 20 about 40-41%.

segments.name: Trade Generics and Institutional
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR195 crores (+13% YoY) but Q4 revenue was INR46 crores; softness in Q3 and Q4 attributed to codeine cough syrup exit and lumpy institutional orders.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR46 crores (+40% YoY); Q4 INR17 crores (+67% YoY). Focus on ROW and semi-regulated markets; Philippines GMP approval for injectables plant obtained.

guidance_outlook: Plant 6 mechanical completion achieved; commercialisation targeted by H1 FY27.
Plant 6 capex expected to finish in H1 FY27; thereafter only maintenance capex planned in FY27, with additional capacity considered in FY28 if performance is strong.
Plant 6 plus existing sites can deliver about INR1,000 crores revenue excluding injectables (about INR100 crores); management cites a further 10-15% capacity efficiency upside.
Management does not give revenue or run-rate guidance; working capital expected to move only 10-15 days plus or minus.
No organic dosage-form expansion planned currently; EU GMP timeline not disclosed.
capex_capacity: Plant 4 and Plant 5 (injectables) received GMP certificate from Philippines in FY26; EU-GMP readiness work ongoing, timeline not given.
Plant 6 mechanical completion achieved; commercialisation by H1 FY27.
Company's capex philosophy: 1.5 to 2.5 year capacity chunks, with new capacity typically added when utilisation nears about 60%.
Injectables facility can fill GLP-1 vials already.
Dosage forms not currently present include ointments, steroids, beta-lactams, soft-gel hormones, eye drops; no organic plans currently.
demand_pricing: Codeine-based cough syrup exit by two large multinational brands hit Trade Generics in Q3 and Q4; management is replacing lost volume through non-codeine cough syrups, Ayurvedic cough syrups and other liquids on shared lines, but could not quantify the compensation.
Export margins are higher across categories; management expects the same for injectables sold to Philippines and ROW markets.
In CDMO, price increases from API cost inflation are passed to customers through an open cost sheet; trade generics and exports price increases are under review.
Indian pharma volume grew 2.7% in FY26 per management.
Management sees GLP-1 vial filling as an opportunity via CDMO but not via trade generics for now; no talks with large retail chains yet.

qa_highlights.question: How concentrated is the CDMO business by customer?
qa_highlights.answer: Top customer 6.5% of FY26 revenue; top 10 about 32%; top 20 about 40-41%.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the codeine business has been replaced on a run-rate basis?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to quantify; compensation varies by line from about 30% to 70% depending on monthly order book, and the overall goal is to protect total revenue.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capacity outlook given strong growth and Plant 6 timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Plant 6 plus existing capacity supports about INR1,000 crores revenue ex-injectables; a further 10-15% efficiency unlock is expected, and no organic capex is planned in FY27 beyond maintenance.

qa_highlights.question: Is working capital reduction sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said working capital levels have held for about 3 years; variations of 10-15 days plus or minus are possible due to external or mix factors.

qa_highlights.question: What is the peak turnover potential across plants?
qa_highlights.answer: Excluding injectables (about INR100 crores), Plant 6 can support about INR1,000 crores revenue, with efficiency upside.

qa_highlights.question: What are the GLP-1 opportunity and plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Facility can fill GLP-1 vials; opportunity is through CDMO as volumes move from in-house launchers, not trade generics; no large retail chain interest yet.

risks_watch: Trade Generics softness from codeine exit; replacement pace and vertical mix unclear for next three quarters.
Institutional business is lumpy, adding quarter-to-quarter volatility.
EU-GMP approval timeline not disclosed; injectables business ramp was behind earlier internal timelines.
API cost inflation linked to West Asia crisis and fuel prices; pass-through on trade generics and exports not yet confirmed.
ESOP cost reduces reported EBITDA and PAT versus adjusted figures (Q4 reported EBITDA INR25 crores vs adjusted INR33 crores).
Plant 6 commercialisation by H1 FY27 and ramp-up efficiency; capacity could tighten if growth continues at about 18-20%.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term growth and cash generation, but cautious and non-committal on near-term Trade Generics recovery, export run-rates, EU-GMP timing and codeine replacement, which management said cannot yet be quantified.
key_quotes: Our highest customer is at 6.5% for the year. And top 10, we are at about 32%.
So we remain positive, very, very positive about the long-term growth potential of trade generics and institutional verticals also going forward.
We do not see ourselves doing a capex, which is like 5 years kind of we're creating capacity for the next 5 years. We want to do it more like 1.5 to 2.5 years kind of chunk.

adds.what: Plant 6 (injectables/dosage facility) reached mechanical completion; commercialisation by H1 FY27

growth.why: Management gives no revenue growth guidance; Plant 6 (mechanical completion done) is targeted for commercialisation by H1 FY27 and could support about INR1,000 crores revenue ex-injectables, but no organic capex is planned for FY27 beyond maintenance and utilisation-based expansion is only considered in FY28.
